d.d: The concept of hospitality to strangers.
The effect that genes from pollen have on the endosperm.
A coral of the genus Xenia of photosynthetic soft marine corals with many-branched arms which pulse and push water around the coral.
The chemical element (symbol Xe) with an atomic number of 54. It is a colorless, odorless, unreactive noble gas, used notably in camera flash technology.
A fear, antipathy, or hatred of strangers or foreigners.
Exhibiting or characterised by xenophobia, a fear or hatred of strangers, foreigners, or extraterrestrial life.
